name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_gameplay_daily_20260803_153216_184570
sql:
/* 固定 D0 创角且 D0 当日活跃 cohort 的 D0-D4 玩法参与率：每日玩法去重参与人数 / D0 活跃用户人数。 */
WITH Config AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start,DATE '2026-08-02' tc_end,DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start),
TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SGC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.u=a.u),
Cohort AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111') GROUP BY 1,2
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id" FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"=CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2
),
E AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) rel_day,e."$part_event" part_ev,e."#event_name" ev,TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) stage_type FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",DATE_DIFF('day',c.sg_start,CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)),e."$part_event",e."#event_name",TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
D0Active AS (
 SELECT c.grp,c.aid
 FROM Cohort c JOIN E e ON c.grp=e.grp AND c.aid=e.aid
 WHERE e.rel_day=0 AND e.part_ev='login'
 GROUP BY 1,2
),
Base AS (SELECT grp,COUNT(*) d0_active_users FROM D0Active GROUP BY 1),
ModeDaily AS (
 SELECT e.grp,e.rel_day,
 CASE WHEN e.ev='stage_fight' THEN CONCAT('副本_',CAST(e.stage_type AS VARCHAR)) WHEN e.ev='match3_combo' THEN '三消' WHEN e.ev='pet_travel_start' THEN '宠物旅行' WHEN e.ev='board_tile_land' THEN '大富翁' END mode,
 COUNT(DISTINCT e.aid) users,COUNT(*) times
 FROM E e JOIN D0Active c ON e.grp=c.grp AND e.aid=c.aid
 WHERE e.ev IN ('stage_fight','match3_combo','pet_travel_start','board_tile_land') GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT m.grp "对比组",CONCAT('D',CAST(m.rel_day AS VARCHAR)) "业务日",m.mode "玩法",m.users "参与人数",m.times "参与次数",b.d0_active_users "D0活跃用户人数",ROUND(100.0*m.users/NULLIF(b.d0_active_users,0),2) "参与率(%)"
FROM ModeDaily m JOIN Base b ON m.grp=b.grp
ORDER BY 1,2,7 DESC;
